description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git operations related to overwriting refs, branch updates, worktrees, fetches, bisect, rebase, and error states. It contains test setup, execution, and validation commands, primarily using Git commands to simulate and verify various conditions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after a test.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that the editor configuration remains unchanged.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets up the editor for interactive rebase editing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
